entries.text: This is the third Release Candidate of Redis 8.12 in Redis Open Source. Release Candidates are feature-complete pre-releases. Pre-releases are not suitable for production use. Security fixes #16127 A TLS session could be resumed on another listener (client port vs. cluster bus), or after tls-auth-clients or tls-expected-peer-name changed, without the checks of the new settings New Features #16135 New commands: ZMOVE, BZMOVE, ZMOVEMEMBER to atomically move members between sorted sets - from either end, by score range, or by name - with COUNT batching and NX/XX destination conditions #15907 SLOWLOG GET now reports the CPU time of each slow command (a new 8th field), to tell commands that ran slowly apart from commands that were starved of CPU; New configuration parameter: off-cpu-tracking Modules API #16105 RedisModule_GetUsedMemoryRatioEstimate - like RedisModule_GetUsedMemoryRatio, but can be called from module threads without holding the GIL Bug fixes #16098 A replica that fell behind by more than its output buffer soft limit was disconnected even when repl-backlog-size was larger #16176 Keys could be lost during atomic slot migration when the destination rejected a command (e.g. -NOREPLICAS due to min-replicas-to-write) #16210 Set members could be expired incorrectly on the destination during atomic slot migration #16096 MSETEX with repeated EX or PX options was propagated to replicas and the AOF as an invalid command, losing the keys #16175 Commands could be replayed twice

entries.text: This is the first Release Candidate of Redis 8.12 in Redis Open Source. Release Candidates are feature-complete pre-releases. Pre-releases are not suitable for production use. Headlines: Redis 8.12 introduces new features and performance improvements. Operating systems we test Redis 8.12 on Ubuntu 22.04 (Jammy Jellyfish), 24.04 (Noble Numbat), 26.04 (Resolute Raccoon) Rocky Linux 8.10, 9.7, 10.1 AlmaLinux 8.10, 9.7, 10.1 Debian 12.13 (Bookworm), Debian 13.4 (Trixie) Alpine 3.23 macOS 14.8.4 (Sonoma), 15.7.4 (Sequoia), 26.3 (Tahoe) - for both Intel and ARM Security fixes RediSearch/RediSearch#10073 Indexed value hashing is now collision-resistant, preventing HashDoS-style index degradation from adversarial input. (MOD-14459) RediSearch/RediSearch#11202 Incomplete UTF-8 characters no longer reads out of bounds in indexed TEXT fields. (MOD-18088) New Features #15331 Compressed bitmaps — Integrated redis-roaring into Redis core for lower memory usage and faster bitmap operations. Special thanks to Antonio, the original creator of redis-roaring, for contributing this capability! https://redisroaring.com/redis-merge/#/1; #15986 New command: BITRANGEINTARRAY equivalent to redis-roaring’s R.RANGEINTARRAY, to return set bit offsets within a specified range #15938 Set expiration to individual set member; New commands: SEXPIRE,SPEXPIRE,SEXPIREAT,SPEXPIREAT to set expiration and STTL, SPTTL, SEXPIRETIME,SPEXPIRETIME to retrieve remaining TTLs or expiration timestamps #15649 Bless keys: a
